criteria.evidence: Explicitly asks 'What capability is actually missing?' and enumerates common actual gaps (correlation, aggregation, retention) vs. what user already has (failure visibility, latency measurement).
Section 2 'Can the existing system solve it directly?' shows how structured logging, decorators, and existing log stacks (CloudWatch/Datadog) can solve 80% of problems without new frameworks.
States framework adds 'new service/SaaS dependency, API keys, network calls from your agent, cost, and a new failure mode' vs. local change being '30–50 lines of code and zero new dependencies'.
